children: The August jobs report came in better than expected, and June and July were better than previously reported, too. June's report was revised up by 11,000 to 31,000. The change for July was revised up by 44,000 to 21,000, reversing a previously reported decline in jobs. Taken together, employment in the summer months was 55,000 higher than first reported. (jessica.coacci@wsj.com)
